_note: Research is done inside the Nhà nghiên cứu by villagers who work there: the more and the smarter, the faster. Tools, weapons, armour and torches have no blueprint (recipe id: axe1 is the wood axe, axe2 the stone one): the level of the Nhà chế tạo alone (recipeLevel) decides which can be made. cost may include coin (shells in the stone age). time is seconds at speed 1 with one average researcher; the best researcher inside must reach minInt. needLevel is the Nhà nghiên cứu level. unlocks: recipes, buildings (kinds that may be built), Set enabled to false to open everything.
